topic: Luffy only awakens the Nika fruit after Kaido beats him
title: Kaido Almost Won And Gear 5 Exists Because Of It
description: The Gum-Gum Fruit was never a reward. Luffy had to lose to Kaido before Gear 5 woke up. A short cut from our full What If: what if Luffy never ate the Gum-Gum Fruit? Full breakdown on the channel.

comment: Would Gear 5 ever have come without Kaido? Pick one.

lines.text: Kaido almost won. Gear 5 exists because of it.

lines.text: Chapter 1044 reveals what the Gum-Gum Fruit really is. Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika.

lines.text: The World Government renamed it, and changed what kind of fruit it was, to bury the truth.

lines.text: It's a Mythical Zoan, the fruit of a Sun God who frees slaves.

shot.fallback: anime style nika sun god, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: In the Void Century, Joy Boy used that power. Luffy had to wake it up.

lines.text: And here's what most people forget. He doesn't awaken it by training.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy wano training, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: He awakens it after Kaido beats him, after he falls, after he's dead.

shot.fallback: anime style kaido luffy onigashima, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: People say Gear 5 would've come eventually. Here's my read. I don't think it would.

lines.text: The fruit woke up because Luffy's mind and body were finally one with it, and it took Kaido to force that.
